title: Breadman MGV - No Way
htmlContent:
Breadman MGV drops a new single titled "No Way", an amazing body work of worth that you know the whole world will be hearing. It’s an incredible display of music, filled with the more people are looking for with a digestible sound, that anyone can hit play on and hear the creative work in the song. From the stellar writing, big time production, and major vocals it all comes together as one to make a stand out tune.
